name: symbol-keyed properties stay out of string-key enumeration and JSON.stringify
source: function main(): void { const key = Symbol('secret'); const o = { visible: 1, [key]: 2 }; console.log(Object.keys(o).join(',')); console.log(Object.values(o).join(',')); console.log(Object.entries(o).map((e) => e.join(':')).join(',')); const seen: string[] = []; for (const k in o) seen.push(k); console.log(seen.join(',')); console.log(JSON.stringify(o)); const dyn: any = o; console.log(Object.keys(dyn).join(','), dyn[key]); const anon = Symbol(); const p = { a: 1, [anon]: 'x' }; console.log(Object.keys(p).join(',')); console.log(Object.keys({ ...p }).join(',')); console.log(Object.keys(Object.assign({}, p)).join(',')); }
